submitter: bugfix-220 lane — followup: the acceptance run's finding (save_sections identity split), fixed as mig 342
rationale: The council-approved 220 fix (corr def4441c) was acceptance-tested live on 2026-08-09 after the fleet roll, and the run proved routing + verifier while exposing the fix's missing third leg: page-build-handler's save_sections step was the ONE step still resolving its page from input_data.spec.page_name while load_spec_sections, load_existing_content, call_content_writer (current_page) and deploy_page all follow page_record — the page load_page_record loads, which since mig 340 honours the work item's authoritative page_id. Consequence, observed live on dartsonline (corr 110acf5a): the writer wrote the TARGET's sections (grip-styles' plan) and save_sections saved them ONTO THE CONTAINER — beginners' content_data was replaced with grip-styles' copy at 10:00:56Z; the sibling item was stopped only by the content-regression floor (2,520 chars of brands-index copy vs brand-comparison's 11,914) and failed loudly. Containment: the container's queued rerenders cancelled (they would have published the contamination — a rerender renders FROM content_data), the remaining unbuilt items cancelled pending this fix, and a consistent-identity repair content-write minted for the damaged page. THE FIX (mig 342, applied + recorded same morning): save_sections.page_name_field = page_record.name — one page identity end-to-end. Blast radius: for every live item type except unbuilt_internal_link, page_record.name == spec.page_name (the 116-lane census the def4441c round already reviewed), so nothing changes; where load_page_record fell back from a non-page marker name to the id, page_record.name is the REAL name, strictly better than the marker string. When page_record is found:false the workflow routes away at check_page_found before save_sections, so the new path cannot dereference a missing record. Config-only; no Go. Submitted alongside the commit per the 2026-07-29 ruling (review after the fact, by design). Numbering note, disclosed: the filename collides with the thunder lane's independent 342_thunder_orphan_scan.sql — the ledger keys on FILENAME so there is no functional clash, and the wrong call is logged.

plan.summary: Complete the 220 fix's identity chain: save_sections follows page_record.name (mig 342, config_change on page-build-handler, content pipeline), closing the split that wrote one page's copy into another page's content_data.

edits.rationale: CONFIG CHANGE, page-build-handler (content pipeline): one jsonb key. $pre$ DO/RAISE refuses on drift or double-apply (expects the exact current value input_data.spec.page_name); $post$ DO/RAISE reads the key back. ROLLBACK sidecar restores the spec path and warns it must only accompany a 340 rollback — reverting it alone re-arms the contamination.

+UPDATE agent_definitions
+   SET default_config = jsonb_set(
+           default_config,
+           '{workflow,steps,save_sections,config,page_name_field}',

+       ),
+       updated_at = NOW()
+ WHERE type = 'page-build-handler'
+   AND is_active AND COALESCE(is_snapshot, false) = false AND deleted_at IS NULL;
